title: Clean The Inventory
description: Quickly clean your inventory by deleting selected items. Keeps your inventory organized and clutter-free.
body:

![Clean The Inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4c22de1c8766bc1ec9fcc1afd2c651b082cd0d3.jpeg)Open the GUI with Z to manage and clean your inventory easily.

Press Z to open the Clean Inventory GUI and manage or remove unwanted items with ease.

🔹 Destroy Feature

Deletes only the items placed in the selected inventory slots.
Useful for removing specific items quickly without affecting the rest of your inventory.

🔹 AutoClean Feature

Deletes both the item in the selected slot and all identical items found anywhere in your inventory.
Ideal for instantly removing all unwanted stacks of a specific item.

🔹 AutoMine Feature

Automatically deletes selected items while mining.

Use AutoMine Update to mark which items should be deleted.

Use AutoMine Reset to clear all items marked for deletion.

When AutoMine is ON, marked items are deleted automatically as you collect them.

Toggle AutoMine ON/OFF using the corresponding button in the GUI.

⚠️ Important Warning

These features permanently delete items.
Incorrect use may result in accidental loss of valuable items.
Please use AutoClean and AutoMine carefully.
